question: What practice is enjoined for one who wears an ochre robe free from bondage, and over what time span is it to be undertaken?
premises: A person who wears an ochre robe free from bondage is indicated.
The practice is to be undertaken from six months onward.
inference: One who wears an ochre robe free from bondage should practice, beginning from six months.
uncertainties: Object of practice not specified in this verse
plain_english: Whoever wears an ochre robe free from bondage should practice from six months onward.
